# Procura West

> Procura West is Amy-Marie Holland's contract procurement practice based in Calgary, Alberta. I provide procurement services for oil & gas and construction companies across Western Canada, augmented by AI tools for faster, more thorough delivery.

## What I Do

I handle services procurement and contract management on a project or contract basis. One specialist with 15 years of experience, amplified by AI - the output of three.

- Contract formation, negotiation, and administration
- Services procurement and contractor sourcing
- Vendor evaluation and qualification
- RFX management (RFP, RFQ, RFI)
- Spend analysis and reporting
- Contractor compliance tracking (COR, ISN, WCB, Avetta, ISNetworld, ComplyWorks, ContractorCheck)
- Invoice review and three-way matching
- Change order administration
- Subcontractor management and onboarding
- Supply chain risk assessment

## Industries I Serve

- **Oil & Gas**: SAGD operators, midstream companies, oilfield service providers in Western Canada. MSA negotiation, field ticket reconciliation, turnaround scoping, vendor compliance, long-lead procurement.
- **Construction**: General contractors, ICI builders, industrial constructors in Alberta. Bid package development, sub-trade prequalification, contract buyout, CCDC contract administration.

## Engagement Model

I work on a contract or project basis - not tiered monthly retainers. Pricing is scoped to the work, whether that is a short-term project, an ongoing contract assignment, or a focused assessment.

## Procurement Gap Analysis

A focused assessment of your supply chain across eight areas: Sourcing & Purchasing, Vendor Management, Contract Management, Subcontractor Management, Spend Visibility, Process & Documentation, Compliance & Safety, and Risk & Supply Chain Resilience. You get specific findings, dollar estimates, and a clear action plan.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How does Procura West work?**
I work on contract or project assignments - the same way companies bring in any specialist. You get one experienced procurement professional, backed by AI tools that let me deliver faster and more thoroughly than a traditional hire.

**How much does contract procurement support cost?**
Pricing is based on scope, duration, and complexity. I quote per project or per contract - no tiered packages, no long-term commitments.

**What industries does Procura West serve?**
Oil & gas and construction companies in Western Canada, typically with 50-500 employees.

**What is a Procurement Gap Analysis?**
A structured assessment of your supply chain across eight areas. You get specific findings, dollar estimates, and a clear action plan.

**Where is Procura West located?**
Calgary, Alberta. I serve clients across Western Canada including Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan.

**What compliance platforms does Procura West manage?**
COR, ISN, WCB, Avetta, ISNetworld, ComplyWorks, and ContractorCheck.
